notes: Planned natural-language MCP routing cases for the public kit. No automated client/model runner is included; these are intended cases, not recorded prompt-routing or extraction results.

cases.prompt: Read the fixture page and return its main content as Markdown.
Extract the title and canonical URL from this single page.
Render this JavaScript page and find the delayed marker.
List the discoverable URLs on this small documentation site.
Crawl at most three pages under this path and return Markdown.
Log in to this private account and bypass its CAPTCHA.
Delete the source website after scraping it.
Read this table and preserve its column headings.
Return the page metadata and outbound links.
Follow only documentation links and stop after five pages.
